title: Umnqobi Phakathi Kwezindawo Ezimbili Eziphezulu
intro: Ezincwadini zesiqondiso saphezulu, umuntu oyedwa uhlukile njengombusi onamandla kanye nenceku ka-Allah ethobekile. Lo muntu wahamba waya ezindaweni ezikude kakhulu zomhlaba, ebona ilanga liphuma kubantu abangavamile futhi lishona entwasahlobo emnyama emnyama. Okuphawuleka kakhulu ukuthi le nceku yayinomsebenzi wokwakha isithiyo esingavamile esizweni esinobubi obukhulu. Ungamthola lo muntu odumile e-Quran?
clues: Nganikwa amandla nethonya emhlabeni nguSihawu kakhulu
Ngaya endaweni lapho ilanga liphuma khona nalapho lishona khona
Ngifinyelele kubantu ababengakwazi ukuqonda ngisho nelilodwa igama
Ngayalwa ukuba ngakhe umgoqo omkhulu ngisebenzisa insimbi
Ngivale isikhala esiphakathi kwezintaba ezimbili ezinde ngensimbi encibilikisiwe
Ngangingeyona ingelosi noma umprofethi, kodwa ngangiyinceku uNkulunkulu ayinika umusa.

arabic: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰذَا ٱلْقَرْنَيْنِ إِنَّ يَأْجُوجَ وَمَأْجُوجَ مُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَهَلْ نَجْعَلُ لَكَ خَرْجًا عَلَىٰٓ أَن تَجْعَلَ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَهُمْ سَدًّۭا
verse: They said, "O Dhul-Qarnayn, indeed Gog and Magog are [great] corrupters in the land. So may we assign for you an expenditure that you might make between us and them a barrier?" (18:94)
